_about: Machoke: grey-blue skin over most textures, white crest (an untextured "flat" material, Machoke's only flats), red-brown muscle lines (0x3ac0, 0x5ce0), black belt and trunks (0x11160, 0xa280, 0x44680) with gold buckle and studs (0x39ae0, 0x49f60 ornaments), mouth (0x94e0, 0xb2a0), red eyes 0x11ee0. Zone outline (stock only) is never named: the stock icon keeps its black outline. Zones s_<part> hold the stock icon's own colours for that part (its sprite palette is darker than the model's) and every team names them like the part.

red._note: heavyweight champ (burgundy): burgundy hide, gold crest and gold-traced muscles, black trunks and the gold belt (the stock icon's muscle lines are dark wine, not gold: gold there reads as specks)

green._note: gamma brute (grass green, kept off emerald and muted: the render lifts it a lot): Hulk-green hide, black-green crest, purple trunks, dark green muscle lines
